bio: Peter Michael, also written Michel, married Maria Elisabeth Grub, who was born on 5 June 1761, a daughter of Andreas Grub; Andreas's will of 1791 names 'Elizabeth the wife of Peter Michael'. In 1790 his household in Forks Township, Northampton County, consisted of one man over sixteen, one boy and four females. Elizabeth was still living in 1826, when the will of her brother-in-law Gottlieb Hipp named her.
